notes: v562 — fixes the ‘suddenly everything is SOLID’ problem you found. CAUSE: the pass marks for SOLID and PROMISING were fixed numbers, but a longer outcome window naturally accumulates a bigger edge — so the same signal could be TOO EARLY on the 5-day view and SOLID on the 10-day view without having improved at all. NOW: the pass mark rises with the window in proportion (SOLID needs strength 2 at 5 days, 2.8 at 10 days, 4.9 at 30 days), so a longer window has to earn it. At 5 days nothing changes — the verdict is exactly the server's, so the card, the radar and 🎯 Best Evidence can never disagree. Badges outside the 5-day view now say which window judged them (‘SOLID·10d’) and the hover explains that tiers from different windows aren't comparable. ALSO NEW: if half a line's sightings finished exactly level — the fingerprint of shares too thin to trade — the line now says so in red and tells you to raise the 💧 tradeable-shares floor. For real decisions: $250k or $1m, and 5d or 30d. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
